content.short: Trident is a Solana fuzzing framework built by Ackee Blockchain Security.
content.description: Trident is a Rust-based framework for fuzzing and integration testing Solana programs, designed to help you ship secure code. It includes automated test generation that creates templates for fuzzing and integration tests for Solana programs written with the Anchor Framework. This automation produces ready-to-use test scaffolds, streamlining the testing workflow for Solana projects. By providing templates for both fuzzing and integration tests, Trident supports a more efficient path to robust, secure deployments on Solana.
